#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

class Task {
public:
    void go() {
        int t = 1;
        while (t > 0) {
            solve();
            t--;
        }
    }

private:
    const int inf = 2000000000;
    const int mod = 1000000007;

    void solve() {
        int n;
        cin >> n;
        vector<vector<int>> dp(2 * n, vector<int>(n + 1, 0));
        dp[0][1] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i < 2 * n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                if (j + 1 <= n) {
                    dp[i][j + 1] = (dp[i][j + 1] + dp[i - 1][j]) % mod;
                }
                if (j - 1 >= 0) {
                    dp[i][j - 1] = (dp[i][j - 1] + dp[i - 1][j]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 2 * n - 2; i >= 0; i -= 2) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                if (j <= 2 * n - 1 - i && j % 2 == 1) {
                    ans = (ans + dp[i][j]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }
        cout << ans;
    }
};

int main() {
    Task task;
    task.go();
    return 0;
}
